item.title: Google Agent Development Kit for Kotlin Reaches Feature Parity with Python, Supports On-Device AI
item.description: Google has released the Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Kotlin 1.0, a production-ready framework for building AI agents across Kotlin, Android, and JVM/server applications. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Alibaba Open Sources OpenCodeReview for AI-Assisted Code Review
item.description: Alibaba recently open-sourced OpenCodeReview, an AI-powered code review CLI that combines deterministic pipelines for file selection, bundling, and rule matching with an LLM agent for dynamic code analysis. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: A Search-and-Inference Database from Scratch in Pure Zig | Antfly
AI Is an Elite Crime Spree
item.description: Documents show a Microsoft exec called AI the "largest theft of labor in human history.” New AI regulations are besides the point, the problem is we don’t apply existing laws to the powerful. (1 source: lobsters)
